name: The Jumbie of Plymouth

intro.text: A jumbie is a ghost, and a good jumbie keeps watch. I look after the old streets. Nobody's left to walk them, so I do.
The clocks are still. The bells are still. The roofs are still. I am still, mostly.
I'm not unfriendly. I'm just buried. Show me what you have.

win: You've treated Plymouth with respect. That is not nothing. Go well.
after: I'll be here. I've got a lot of time, and it's a great view of the ash.
